title: Blue Vinyl Player

fields.label: Function
fields.value: The only way to play the Vinyls

body:
"Plays all sorts of records! Emits across your entire property."

Description

The Blue Vinyl Player is the only way to play the Vinyls in the game. You put a Vinyl in there and it will play the music around your entire property! but then you leave your property the sound stops playing. If you reset the area it plays at, you gotta put it where you want it to play music or around your entire base again.

As of 10-3-2024 there are 19 vinyls available to be purchase and used on the Vinyl Player, with 3 limited discs available through trading or the Halloween event.

The player can also be interacted with via the Interactor. A value of 0 will stop the song, a value of 5 will start playing the song, and any other value will eject the vinyl. There is an option ''Define Region''. that is the region the music plays at. if you remove that region, the music wont play where you removed it. this way, you can make different vrevs in your base have different music.
